response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a highly experienced, versatile software engineer with strong web, backend, and systems programming background, but his profile does not align with this role's core requirement of deep, current C++ expertise for high-performance, secure industrial/IoT platform development. His C++ experience is limited to a brief stint over a decade ago, and his recent decade of work is focused on TypeScript/Node.js/DLang web and product engineering, with no evidence of IEC 62443, MQTT, message brokers, industrial protocols, or SDL security practices.
strengths: Extensive 15+ year software engineering career with broad technical range (web, mobile, embedded, systems)
Demonstrated strong craftsmanship practices: TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, workshops, and open-source contributions
Experience with low-latency, high-performance systems (DLang, async I/O, fibers) showing systems-level aptitude
concerns: Minimal and outdated C++ experience (~6 months in 2014-2015), not the 8-12 years of C++ expertise required
No evidence of IoT protocols (MQTT, REST for IoT), message brokers, or industrial automation domain experience
No mention of IEC 62443, Secure Development Lifecycle, or industrial cybersecurity practices required for this role

key_factors.factor: Lack of substantial recent C++ expertise
No industrial cybersecurity (IEC 62443/SDL) or IoT protocol experience
Strong general software engineering and systems background
